# AmaraVisa

> Premium visa consultancy for Indian passport holders. Transparent fees, human consultants, on-time filing.

## Site

- Home: /
- Visa catalog and applications: /visa/{productId}
- Sign in: /auth (not for indexing)
- Account & case tracking: /account, /status/{caseId} (private)

## Key facts

- Audience: Indian passport holders applying for tourist, business, and other visas
- Service: document guidance, consultant review, embassy filing support
- Location: Gandhinagar, Gujarat (serves applicants across India)
